regime: Risk-off FOMC day. NQ and ES flipped short and closed on their lows after a divided 9-3 hold; gold caught a haven bid, crude squeezed on Middle East headlines.
summary: FOMC day went risk-off. The Fed held at 3.50 to 3.75 percent in a divided 9-3 vote and kept a hawkish tone, and the tape sold it. NQ gave back the pre-decision pop and closed on its lows at 27,259.75, down 2.5 percent and flipping short below its 27,832 stop. ES mirrored it, down 1.77 percent and also short. VIX jumped 13.45 percent to 20.66 and the 10-year yield rose. Gold caught a haven bid, up 0.93 percent, but it is still under its trailing stop, so treat it as a bounce, not a trend flip. Crude was the outlier, squeezing 7.0 percent off its two-day flush on Middle East headlines and flipping long.
psychology: Event days punish anticipation. Plenty of traders sat long into the decision because the hold was a foregone conclusion, then watched the reaction go the other way. Your job is not to predict the print, it is to trade the reaction after it prints. Sitting out the decision is a position.

fullReport.title: Momentum Breakout
fullReport.html: E3v2 Momentum Long is out of habitat in a down tape, so no long breakout is in scope. The edge that fit today was short-side trend continuation: NQ broke its opening range down, lost its AVWAP and its 27,832 ATR stop, and trended to the close. The cleaner read was the stop flip and AVWAP loss early, not chasing the breakdown late.
